model_type: Edge Multimodal Vision-Language Model (e.g., Qwen2.5-VL-3B, PaliGemma 2, SmolVLM-2.2B quantized to INT4/INT8)
deployment_location: Local Edge Gateway Server / On-Premise Clinic Machine via LAN REST API (or high-end 8GB+ RAM mobile device via MLC-LLM)
privacy_compliance: 100% private and on-premise. Image and patient data remain confined to the local facility or home Wi-Fi network; zero cloud transmission, fully compliant with HIPAA, GDPR, and Philippine DPA.
on_device_binary_size_impact: 0 MB when hosted on local clinic/gateway server. If attempted as an embedded on-device mobile bundle, weights impose an impractical 1.8 GB to 3.2 GB binary footprint.
printed_label_accuracy: Very High (93-97% field accuracy). Direct visual transformer architecture avoids cascading OCR bounding box errors on complex packaging.
handwriting_recognition: High (72-84% accuracy on messy physician sigs and clinical abbreviations due to joint vision-language representation learning).
multilingual_code_switching_support: Very High. Handles colloquial Philippine eldercare phrasing ('tuwing gabi', 'pagkatapos kumain', 'kalahating tableta') seamlessly in end-to-end multimodal generation.
curved_surface_and_glare_tolerance: High. Visual attention mechanisms naturally model curved cylindrical label geometries and glare occlusions without requiring manual dewarping algorithms.
tabular_timetable_parsing: Very High. 2D spatial patch embeddings retain full grid layout of hospital discharge timetables and medication matrices without row/column crosstalk.
hallucination_under_degraded_input: Moderate risk. Under heavy blur or physical label tears, small 2B-3B VLMs may invent plausible clinical dosages. Requires temperature=0 and strict schema constrained decoding (such as Outlines or GBNF).
latency_seconds: 1.8 to 4.5 seconds on an edge GPU/NPU (RTX 3060 / Apple Silicon M-series); 8 to 18 seconds on CPU-only local machines.
ram_peak_footprint: 2.4 GB to 4.2 GB VRAM/RAM during visual token encoding and KV cache generation.
cost_profile: 100% Free open-source software license. Requires one-time local hardware investment ($400-$800 for edge workstation/mini PC), with zero recurring API or token costs.
react_native_compatibility: Fully compatible via HTTP/WebSocket connection from React Native to the local edge gateway (matching Alaga's current client-server architecture).
offline_readiness: 100% offline within LAN. Operates without public internet connection in rural clinics and community healthcare centers.
structured_output_support: High. Integrates with constrained grammar engines (llama.cpp grammar or SGLang/vLLM guided decoding) to directly output Alaga's MedicationOcrDraft schema.
formulary_grounding_readiness: High. Extracted medication names and dosage strings are clean and canonical, allowing direct validation against the Philippine National Drug Formulary (PNDF).
